jobsmenu.subtitulo: NOTICE TO OCCUPANTS OF THIS LEVEL
jobsmenu.aviso.0: The exit is real. It costs what it costs.
jobsmenu.aviso.1: No refunds on a shift. What is worked stays worked.
jobsmenu.aviso.2: Money is worthless here. It is only good for leaving.
jobsmenu.aviso.3: If you hear the humming stop, it was not the light.
jobsmenu.aviso.4: Executors do not charge, do not bargain and do not tire.
jobsmenu.aviso.5: Please do not count the levels out loud.
jobsmenu.aviso.6: Whoever crosses the doorway unpaid comes back in the way they left.
jobsmenu.aviso.7: Thank you for your continued stay. It is involuntary, but appreciated.
jobsmenu.nivel0.nota: No exit is signposted. The wallpaper never ends.
jobsmenu.nivel1.nota: There is far too much room here for one person.
jobsmenu.nivel2.nota: The pipes are still hot. Nobody turned them on.
jobsmenu.nivel3.nota: The water is warm. The echo takes too long to come back.
